---
title: "Plane Equilibrium System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& xz\\
\dot{y} &=& axz^2-x^2y\\
\dot{z} &=& -x^2+xy
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=3$ and initial condition $(1,2,-1)$.


An animation showing the pre-computed solution trajectory in the phase space
colored with the local lyapunov coefficients for the current chaotic system can
be seen below.
